## Who shares our characteristics

## What differs and must be verified
GNAO1 disease looks similar but has no supported shared mechanism here, so it is excluded. [f94ad5494a3e9ab8]
CACNA1A overlaps at Regulation of insulin secretion, which is a different step. [34c9bc447921f8cb, 187be2699f417de6, 3a40a3f53a18b664]
SLC2A1 overlaps at Regulation of insulin secretion, which is a different step. [20c30f77dc2491fb, 5490966f0991bdf8, 3a40a3f53a18b664]
GRIN1 overlaps at Neurexins and neuroligins, which is a different step. [9b5a310872598764, 072a91fd2fdb335f, ce6dd3aad07a277e]
STXBP1 shows loss of function, while CACNA1A shows gain of function. [87257c69fcfbcdad, df57b34e24ef5206, 4e69b8ecbf6740e9, c3ec464ea6412040]

Some reports find no link between seizure and thinking severity. [b1f9e5eeafbc81d2]
Some reports find no link between mutation type and seizure or cognition. [e362983ef11a54b1]
Some reports find no clear syndromes tied to recurrent variants. [ddc8cd6784a496fb]
